title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: combining the monthly rate and first-cycle setup fee into one billed amount
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, the amount billed to the employer's master account for a billing cycle is the enrollment's recurring monthly per-employee rate, plus the first-cycle wellness-program setup fee where that first-cycle fee applies, summed once. That sum is then itself rounded to 2 decimal places to produce the final amount billed. On a cycle where no first-cycle setup fee applies, the amount billed is simply the recurring monthly rate, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Worked example (hypothetical, using illustrative figures rather than any tier's actual rate): if a monthly per-employee rate were $18.00 and a first-cycle setup fee of $4.50 applied, the amount billed for that first cycle would be the sum of those two figures, $22.50, rounded to 2 decimal places. On every later cycle, with no setup fee applying, the amount billed would be the monthly rate alone.
